model_annotation: This plot illustrates economic data over time, specifically comparing "Exporte" (exports) and "Importe" (imports) as lines, alongside a "Saldo" (balance) represented by vertical bars, with values measured "in Mrd. US-Dollar" (in billions of US Dollars). The x-axis represents time on a linear scale, starting at the year 2020 and ending late in the year 2023, with minor tick marks indicating intervals and major tick labels displaying the years 2020, 2021, 2022, and repeating 2023 three times. The plot features two y-axes: the left y-axis, which corresponds to the line data, has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 with tick label intervals of 50; the right y-axis, corresponding to the bar data, has a linear scale ranging from -200 to 400 with tick label intervals of 100. The "Importe (linke Skala)" data is represented by a solid blue line without markers, which begins at approximately 200 in early 2020, experiences an initial decline to roughly 165, and then follows a general upward trend, reaching a peak of about 290 in early 2022 before fluctuating between 250 and 280, and finally rising sharply to end at approximately 350. The "Exporte (linke Skala)" data is shown as a solid purple line without markers, starting at roughly 135 in early 2020, dropping to a low of approximately 90 shortly after, and then steadily increasing to about 180 by mid-2022, after which it remains relatively steady, fluctuating slightly and ending near 180.
